Mozilla PDF.js 5.6.205, Apache-2.0.
https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
Bundled from the installed pdfjs-dist package: legacy/build/pdf.mjs and pdf.worker.mjs,
cmaps and standard_fonts. Compatibility build is used for wider browser support.
See LICENSE and standard_fonts/LICENSE_* for licenses.
No CDN dependency. Used to extract text with physical PDF page numbers in the browser.
